notes.title: Dreamlord Update to V1.1!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! we've updated to v1.1 to fix some things!
The new features are:
[list]
[*]Higher resolution, 1920x1080
[*]Higher FPS count
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[*]Some additions and changes to the GUI.
[*] And finally, now the first few people to complete the game on hard with Hardcore mode switched ON get a free T-shirt from the dev! You'd better go try your luck against The Dreamlord now if you want a chance of getting one!
[/list]
The saving system has been tested, and will work with previous saves so don't worry.

Thanks for all the feedback everyone, constructive criticism is always welcome!
